episodeTitle.en: An 86-minute guide to finding PMF | Rob Snyder (Author, The Power of Pull)
episodeTitle.zh: 寻找产品与市场匹配的 86 分钟指南｜《The Power of Pull》作者 Rob Snyder

guestBioOfficial.zh: Rob Snyder 是《The Power of Pull》作者，写作 The Physics of Startups 通讯。他做过创始人，也辅导过五十多家早期公司。他的出发点来自一次切身体会：可以努力卖上两年，仍没摸到市场真正想要的东西。
guestBioOfficial.en: Rob wrote The Power of Pull and publishes The Physics of Startups. A founder who later advised over fifty early-stage companies, he draws on his own experience trying for two years to sell a product the market did not want.

title.en: An 86-minute guide to finding PMF | Rob Snyder (Author, The Power of Pull)
title.zh: 寻找产品与市场匹配的 86 分钟指南｜《The Power of Pull》作者 Rob Snyder

summary.zh: 怎样分辨「我把东西卖出去了」和「客户原本就在找它」？Rob 把 PULL 框架放进早期创业的具体场景，从发现想服务的人、进行销售电话，到识别会主动持续使用的客户。
summary.en: Rob distinguishes winning a sale from finding customers who were already searching for a solution. He applies his PULL framework to firsthand discovery, sales calls, and the behavior of unusually motivated customers.

insights.title: 在有一手经验的人群里找起点
insights.detail: 产品会带来成千上万个小决定。Rob 认为，直接了解想服务的人，能在这些决定上提供头脑风暴给不了的依据。
insights.detailEn: Firsthand knowledge of a customer group helps a founder make thousands of small decisions that brainstorming alone cannot settle.
insights.titleEn: Start where you have firsthand knowledge

insights.title: 销售电话先发现需求，再提出帮助
insights.detail: Rob 把通话分成两段，先听处境，再说能怎样帮忙。他留意的是，对方听完方案会不会主动往前走。
insights.detailEn: Separate discovery from the conceptual pitch, then observe whether the buyer moves toward the offer without being pushed.

insights.title: 用购买前后的行为识别理想客户
insights.detail: 有些人在买前就迫不及待想用，买后又持续回来。Rob 建议先找到这种反复出现的行为，再找更多处境相似的人。
insights.detailEn: Look for people who want the product before the sale and keep using it afterward. Then look for more buyers in that situation.

related.reason: 用待完成任务访谈还原客户决定更换方案的具体时刻。
related.reasonEn: Use Jobs-to-be-Done interviews to reconstruct a customer’s decision to switch.
